job_description:
Backend Developer

We build web services for retail customers and need a developer to join the backend team. You will extend our Django application, design REST endpoints and keep the PostgreSQL database healthy.

Responsibilities:
- Develop new features and fix defects.
- Improve the performance of slow queries.
- Package the application with Docker.
- Work with product managers on small deliveries.

Requirements:
- Python and Django.
- PostgreSQL and REST design.
- Docker and Git.

We handle high traffic during seasonal sales, so scalable design matters.
